preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in names)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list must be strings.
No name in the input list is empty or whitespace-only.

postconditions.description: The output list has the same length as the input list.
Every code in the output list is exactly 4 characters long.
Every code in the output list is in uppercase.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalpha() for c in code) for code in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every code in the output list contains only alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == generate_code(names[i]) for i in range(len(names)))
postconditions.description:
Each code in the output list is generated according to the rules for the corresponding input name, where generate_code(name) is defined as follows:

- If the name has one word (after replacing hyphens with spaces), take the first four letters.
- If the name has two words, take the first two letters of each word.
- If the name has three words, take the first letter of the first two words and the first two letters of the third word.
- If the name has four words, take the first letter of each word.

The word count is determined by splitting the name on whitespace (after replacing hyphens with spaces).
